name: Ilias
site: lufthansagroup.com · Airline and aviation group, Germany
headline: Turn Lufthansa’s booking data into customers who keep flying.
saw: In airline pricing, the same fare and offer is usually shown to every customer on a route, whatever their history with the group. A regular business traveller and an occasional leisure customer see the same thing.

Booking history, changes, cancellations, cabin upgrades and the trips a customer never books are the strongest signals you own for the next offer and the next lost customer. Today they sit in pricing and analytics, not in the message the customer receives.

Cross-sell, upsell and retention campaigns are built by hand, per segment, per month. The customer who is about to rebook with another airline this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the defection before it happens
cases.text: Churn signals per customer from booking changes, cancellations and lapsed bookings between trips. The right offer, channel and moment, picked for each customer and tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Match the next offer to each customer
cases.text: Next best cabin, upgrade or add-on per customer, based on what they booked and how they fly. No more blanket mails sent to everyone on the same route.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep every customer engaged between trips
cases.text: Personal content and offers per customer, orchestrated across email and messages so each customer has a reason to book again. Timing set per customer, not per campaign calendar.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
